messages.proxy.hint: All of the backend's outbound traffic goes through this HTTP proxy: accessing Pixiv (browsing, searching, downloading images/ugoira/novels/covers, bookmarking), online updates (checking and downloading new versions), downloading the bundled FFmpeg (needed for ugoira conversion), and online TTS (the Edge neural voices used by "Listen"). When running in a Docker container, 127.0.0.1 usually cannot reach a proxy on the host, so disable it or enter a proxy address reachable from the container.
